notes: Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep and Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu are Administrator-run Union Territories with no elected Legislative Assembly and no Council of Ministers, so no st-<code>-pos-minister-* positions exist for them (confirmed by loading data/raw/states-an-ld-dh.json: its 9 positions are only Lieutenant Governor/Administrator, Chief Secretary-equivalent and DGP-equivalent, with no minister ids). Departments therefore have no political headPositionId; instead 'heads' relations run directly from the Lieutenant Governor/Administrator position (the constitutional executive head under Art. 239/239A) to each department, matching how these administrations actually work: secretaries report straight to the LG/Administrator, not to a minister. Chief-Secretary-equivalent 'oversees' relations use the existing st-<code>-pos-chief-secretary id even where its title is 'Advisor to the Administrator' (Lakshadweep, DNH&DD), matching the existing file's own labelling. Secretary appointments are sourced from each UT's live secretariat/IAS-officers directory (as of 2026-09-25 for A&N; DNH&DD's IAS-officer allocation page is dated 11/03/2026, the most recent posting order publicly available); many single officers hold several department secretaryships as additional charge (a real, sourced feature of small-UT administration, not an error) -- where two officers' listed charges overlapped for the same subject, confidence is marked 'medium' and the alternative officer is named in notes. Departments/positions with no identifiable secretary in the sources reached (e.g. Municipal Corporation DH, District Disaster Management Authority, Directorate of Public Grievance DH, Directorate of Accounts DH, Pay & Accounts LD, Police/IRBn where the existing DGP/SP position already covers the role) were left without a secretary position rather than guessed. WebSearch budget was exhausted for this session before this segment started; all sourcing here used curl + BeautifulSoup against the UTs' own *.gov.in portals plus WebFetch.

verification.method: Re-fetched each UT's live official secretariat/IAS-officer directory (andamannicobar.gov.in/contact, andamannicobar.gov.in/department + /'departmental websites' list, lakshadweep.gov.in/lakshadweep-administration, ddd.gov.in/ias, ddd.gov.in/secretariat, ddd.gov.in/departments) via WebFetch/curl and cross-checked against this file's 110 positions and 122 departments; also reused this segment's own scratch/*.html (already-fetched sources) for DH portfolio detail. WebSearch was unavailable (session budget exhausted) so verification relied on WebFetch + curl against primary .gov.in sources only.
verification.idAndSchemaCheck: PASS: 0 duplicate ids, 0 ids violating st-<code>-dept-*/st-<code>-pos-secretary-* rules, 0 dangling orgId/relation references. File correctly has no headPositionId on entities (notes explain these are Administrator-run UTs with no elected ministers); heads/oversees relations run from st-<code>-pos-lieutenant-governor|administrator and st-<code>-pos-chief-secretary instead, and all of those ids resolve into data/raw/states-an-ld-dh.json.
verification.postingsChecked: 110 of 110 secretary postings (exceeds the 25 minimum): every holder name in st-an-*, st-ld-*, st-dh-* matched a name on the corresponding live official directory page. No stale or incorrect postings found; none removed.
verification.departmentCoverageChecked: Cross-checked all three UTs' department lists against live official sources. AN: matched against andamannicobar.gov.in's own departmental-websites list + contact/department pages; no missing major department found (this UT has no standalone Water Resources/PHE or Women & Child Development department — WCD is folded into Social Welfare, confirmed by absence from the official portal list, not an omission in this file). LD: matched against lakshadweep.gov.in's 7-secretary administration page; all listed portfolios map onto entities already in this file. DH: matched against ddd.gov.in/departments/ (44 official departments) — 44/44 present in this file (plus Home and Parliamentary Affairs, which are real DH portfolios per ddd.gov.in/ias/ but not itemised on the /departments/ listing page); only 'District Collectorate' was on the official page and intentionally not modelled here as it is a district office, not a secretariat department.
verification.correctionsMade: Added 3 previously-missing DH departments + secretary positions + relations, sourced from this segment's own scratch/dh_ias.html (ddd.gov.in/ias/, already fetched by the original build): st-dh-dept-food-civil-supplies, st-dh-dept-tribal-welfare (notable given DNH's majority-ST population), st-dh-dept-mines — all three are additional charges of the existing Secretary (Revenue) Shri Ajay Kumar Gupta, IAS, confidence 'medium' as they are additional-charge appointments. No existing entity, position or relation was altered or removed.
